{{Quote|TD-5144 was from Pargaux, which was a matriarchy back before Ruusan. Nearly as big as a Houk and twice as mean.|[[Isila Drutch]]|<ref name="EGTWF" />}}
'''TD-5144''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual from the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Pargaux]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] within the [[291st Legion/Legends|291st Legion Dalisor]]. From her compatriot [[Isila Drutch|TD-4388's]] recollections, TD-5144 was apparently very vicious, as she noted that she was "twice as mean" as a Houk.<ref name="EGTWF" />
